To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

in patients with primary bile cirrhosis (PBC) hepatic uptake of 99mTechnetium (Tc)-PMT was reduced with the progression of the disease, but hepatic excretion of the tracer was not related to this progression; and that in patients with PBC the gallbladder function was reduced, but this reduction was not related to disease progression.
